<Subject 2> is the single matched pair of crescent mechanical blades shown in <Picture 1>, exactly one blade in each hand. Both retain their white plating, black mechanical structure, circular gold joints, curved segmented edges, and gold blade tips.

retention_analysis:  
<Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - preserve exactly one battle doll with the face, hair, head modules, armor panels, mechanical limbs and armored high-heeled boots shown in <Picture 1>. The multiple views in the reference sheet must not become additional characters.  
<Subject 2> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - preserve exactly two crescent blades, one in each hand. Do not create additional weapons, merge the blades or transform them into chains.

detailed_description:  
Premium 16:9 landscape 2D anime action film with precise cel shading, sharp linework, hand-painted night-city backgrounds, dramatic perspective and controlled sakuga motion smears. Compose specifically for a wide horizontal frame. Do not reproduce the character-sheet layout, white background, labels or multiple character views.

[Shot 1] A fast low tracking shot follows <Subject 1> sprinting from left to right across a narrow elevated rooftop in a densely layered East Asian city at night. Warm windows, cyan signs, pipes and overhead cables spread across the wide background. The damp rooftop reflects streaks of light. She carries one folded crescent blade in each hand. Her pointed armored boots move through a clear alternating running cycle, and each gold-edged heel produces a brief amber propulsion pulse at toe-off. Her long silver-white ponytail streams naturally behind her.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera arcs toward her front three-quarter side. Her golden eyes and pale face remain sharp while the background stretches into horizontal motion blur. She rotates both wrists outward, opening the two crescent blades along their circular gold joints. The weapons lock into full curved form without crossing her face or intersecting her arms.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.200, she reaches the rooftop edge, plants both pointed toes and fires one synchronized pulse from the heel vents. She launches outward and rotates into a controlled headfirst descent between tall buildings. The camera rolls with her and then follows diagonally downward, keeping buildings visible on both sides of the 16:9 frame. She spreads the two blades apart for balance and alternates short heel pulses to rotate upright.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.100, the illuminated wet street rapidly approaches. She draws both knees upward, turns upright and lands at street level on both armored boots. The ankle mechanisms compress and the heel vents release two small braking bursts, scattering shallow water. At exactly 00:06.000, she holds a low stable crouch on the street, one blade extended to each side, head raised and golden eyes looking forward. The descent is complete, but the fight has not started. Exactly one heroine and two weapons remain visible. No deformation, duplicate limbs, merged legs, malformed hands, extra weapons, text, logo, watermark or black borders.

overall_soundscape:  
Fast metallic footsteps, compact heel-thruster pulses, rushing rooftop wind, mechanical blade deployment, accelerating air during the descent, and a controlled wet landing with ankle compression. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:  
Fast electronic-orchestral action music with tight percussion, pulsing bass and rapid strings. The music rises during the descent and lands on one strong beat as her boots contact the street.
